title: CVE-2026-116052 — LinkStackOrg LinkStack cross-site request forgery
summary: Affected: LinkStackOrg LinkStack A security flaw has been discovered in LinkStackOrg LinkStack up to 4.8.8. The affected element is an unknown function. Performing a manipulation results in cross-site request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: CVE-2026-116137 — adm-zip through 0.6.1 Duplicate-Entry Validation Bypass via Canonically Equivalent Names
summary: Affected: cthackers adm-zip adm-zip through 0.6.1 contains a duplicate-entry validation bypass that allows attackers to evade the readEntries() check by using canonically equivalent entry names like './hello.txt' and 'hello.txt'. Attackers can craft ZIP archives where getEntry() or readAsText() validates benign content while extractAllTo() writes malicious content to the same path, bypassing integrity checks.

title: CVE-2026-116136 — ProjectSend 2.0.0 through 2.7.1 Incorrect Authorization via File Version Linking
summary: Affected: ProjectSend ProjectSend 2.0.0 through 2.7.1 contains an incomplete authorization vulnerability in FileVersions::link() that allows staff users to share files without authorization by linking file versions. Attackers can link their file onto an intermediate revision or assign out-of-scope clients, causing moveAssignmentsToRoot() to expose protected original files to unauthorized clients.

title: CVE-2026-116073 — Leon before commit 50df142 Path Traversal via /download model Command
summary: Affected: leon-ai leon Leon before commit 50df142 contains a path traversal vulnerability in getModelFileNameFromURL() that allows attackers to write files outside the models directory via percent-encoded separators. Attackers can trick a user into running '/download model' with a crafted URL containing encoded '../' sequences to write attacker-controlled content to arbitrary paths writable by Leon.

title: CVE-2026-116072 — Infinity for Reddit through 8.3.4 OAuth Login CSRF via LoginChromeCustomTabActivity
summary: Affected: Docile-Alligator Infinity for Reddit Infinity for Reddit through 8.3.4 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to log victims into an attacker-controlled account because the exported LoginChromeCustomTabActivity redirect handler checks a hardcoded OAuth state value. Attackers can authorize the app's client ID with their own Reddit account, then deliver an infinity://localhost redirect containing their code and the constant state, causing the victim's posts, messages, and browsing to occur on the attacker's account.

title: CVE-2026-116071 — rotki before 1.44.2 Weak Key Derivation for Premium Cloud Backup Encryption
summary: Affected: rotki rotki before 1.44.2 contains a weak key derivation vulnerability that allows attackers to brute-force backups because the premium sync key is a single unsalted SHA-256 of the user password. Attackers who obtain an uploaded backup blob can run GPU-parallel offline password guessing and decrypt the database containing exchange API keys, secrets, wallet addresses and transaction history.

title: CVE-2026-116070 — Docker-Proxy through 5.1.9 Missing Authentication via hubcmdui /api/config
summary: Affected: dqzboy Docker-Proxy Docker-Proxy through 5.1.9 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the hubcmdui routes/config.js that allows unauthenticated attackers to read and overwrite configuration via /api/config. Attackers can retrieve the WeChat webhook URL and Telegram bot token, and overwrite menuItems links, proxyDomain, and the monitoring webhook destination receiving alerts.

title: CVE-2026-116069 — NiubiGEO before 0.3.2 Unauthenticated SSRF via /audit-plan domain Field
summary: Affected: Albert-Weasker niubigeo NiubiGEO before 0.3.2 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to make the server fetch internal addresses by supplying a crafted domain value to POST /audit-plan. Attackers can submit IP literals, localhost, or private and link-local hosts to read loopback, internal-network, or cloud metadata responses returned in the plan's siteEvidence JSON.

title: CVE-2026-116068 — Dokploy through 0.30.10 Cross-Organization Authorization Bypass via Application tRPC Router
summary: Affected: dokploy Dokploy through 0.30.10 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows owners or admins of any organization to control other tenants' applications by supplying foreign applicationId values. Attackers can call procedures like saveEnvironment, updateTraefikConfig, deploy, or stop to overwrite environment variables and build secrets, repoint sources, and disrupt other tenants' applications.

title: CVE-2026-116067 — Paisa before 0.7.8 Path Traversal via Editor and Sheet API
summary: Affected: ananthakumaran paisa Paisa before 0.7.8 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the GetFile, GetSheet, DeleteBackups, and DeleteSheetBackups handlers that lets unauthenticated attackers read files and delete backups through ../ sequences in file names. Attackers can send crafted names to the editor file and delete_backups endpoints to read any server-readable file and remove backup files outside the journal or sheets directory.
